items.html: The upper Emanator that emanated the world of Atzilut is called by the name E"S [Ein Sof], due to the abundance of its concealment, deep, deep, who can find it? And the existence of the E"S is called in the Idra Zuta by the name Atika deChol Atikin [the Ancient of all ancients]. And the matter is, that before His clothing no one can attain Him at all; therefore, in order that there be the possibility for the lower ones to receive some illumination from Him, He clothed and hid in the Sefira of Keter, as mentioned in the Sifra deTzniuta and in the Tikkunim, that they said that E"S is concealed and hidden in the supernal Keter. And after His clothing in it, there is power in the lower ones to receive some illumination from Him.
